title: Traditional Games
text:
Many children play traditional games. One popular game is hide and seek. One child closes their eyes and counts. The other children hide.

Another game is hopscotch. Children draw boxes on the ground with chalk. They jump from box to box on one foot. It is fun to play with friends.

questions.text: What does the child do in hide and seek?
options: One child closes their eyes and counts.
They draw boxes on the ground.

questions.text: What do children draw on the ground in hopscotch?
Why do the other children hide in hide and seek?
options: So the child who counts can look for them

questions.text: How do the children probably feel about hopscotch?
options: They like playing it with friends
They do not know the game

vocabulary.definition: an activity with rules that people play for fun
to go somewhere others cannot see you
a soft stick used to draw on the ground
people you like and play with

paragraph_translations: Wiele dzieci gra w tradycyjne gry. Jedną z popularnych zabaw jest zabawa w chowanego. Jedno dziecko zamyka oczy i liczy. Pozostałe dzieci się chowają.
Inną grą jest gra w klasy. Dzieci rysują kredą kwadraty na ziemi. Skaczą z kwadratu na kwadrat na jednej nodze. Zabawa jest fajna, kiedy bawi się z przyjaciółmi.
